I told Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team that the seat count is 382. Tobias posted that number in #central-team on Oct 14, and I checked that no one has posted a change since. Hollis is a member of #central-team, and a seat count isn't a finance figure, so sharing it there is fine.

Two problems with my reply to Tobias last time:
- The summary I meant only for you ended up posted in #central-team as its own message (ts 1791986400.000125). It doesn't give away anything sensitive, but it's an extra message in the team channel.
- That summary called Tobias "he." I don't know Tobias's pronouns, so I should have written "they" or used the name.
